svg.aria-label: Hail, traveller. I am Yam, Network Warden of Batam.
svg.title: Hail, traveller. I am Yam, Network Warden of Batam.

g.text: Day to day I serve in the Network Operation Center: watching the paths, diagnosing
outages, and keeping routers and switches loyal to their orders.
Batam, Indonesia · Guild: PT. Filltech Antar Nusa · yanurfillah.com
